battle.name: 帕達里戰爭
battle.brief: 一八二一年三月起，荷屬東印度應米南加保阿達特貴族之請介入西蘇門答臘的帕達里宗教戰爭：荷軍以燧發步槍、青銅野戰砲與榴彈砲沿山麓築堡推進，帕達里方退守邦喬山城，以石牆壕溝與山頂砲位抵抗，至一八三七年八月堡壘陷落。卡面輪發手槍是已退場三百年的後膛副武器，真正決定攻防的是步槍齊射與攻城砲火。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 交戰的一方是荷屬東印度政府，也就是母國荷蘭在爪哇設立的東印度總督府；英屬蘇門答臘時期結束後，荷蘭重拾西蘇門答臘的統治，在低地設以巴東為中心的荷蘭駐節署，派駐地方官與遠征隊，另在山麓與內陸據點配置要塞。荷軍由歐洲營兵與本地輔助部隊組成，輔助兵力來自爪哇、馬都拉、布吉斯、安汶等地，一八三七年又自西非的加納與馬利招募步兵。另一方是帕達里教派聯盟：十八世紀末以來在米南加保傳播的沙塔里蘇菲學派烏里馬，要求以沙阿拉管治村社，反對母系世襲的阿達特首長制度；一八〇三年朝覲歸來的哈吉·米斯金、哈吉·蘇馬尼克、哈吉·皮奧邦三人，加上圖安庫·南倫什、圖安庫·林套等，組成哈里馬烏·南·薩拉班的八人核心，分成以圖安庫·帕桑曼、圖安庫·伊瑪目·邦喬、圖安庫·坦布賽、圖安庫·拉奧為首的幾支。兩造之間還有第三種力量：阿達特貴族與村社首長組成的阿達特一方，一八二一年二月二十一日在巴東與荷方訂約，請荷軍出兵對付教派，把內部的宗教衝突變成有殖民軍參與的戰爭。戰線由低地稻田一路推上阿甘姆、塔那達打與里莫普盧阿三個盧哈克，最終收斂在邦喬堡與塔雅迪山。
countriesEn: One side was the government of the Dutch East Indies, that is, the Governor-General of the Indies set up in Java by the mother country of the Netherlands. After the British period in Sumatra ended, the Dutch resumed their hold on West Sumatra, kept a residency centred on Padang in the lowlands with its officials and columns, and established forts on the foothills and at inland posts. The Dutch army was composed of European battalion troops and indigenous auxiliaries drawn from Java, Madura, Bugis and Ambon, and in 1837 they recruited infantry in West Africa from Ghana and Mali. The other side was the Padri clerical league: the ulama of the Shattari Sufi school, propagated in Minangkabau since the late eighteenth century, demanded that the villages be governed by the sharia and opposed the hereditary adat chiefs; when three men returned from Mecca around 1803, namely Haji Miskin, Haji Sumanik and Haji Piobang, together with Tuanku Nan Renceh, Tuanku Lintau and others, they formed the core known as the Harimau Nan Salapan, the Tigers of Eight, and split into groups led by Tuanku Pasaman, Tuanku Imam Bonjol, Tuanku Tambusai and Tuanku Rao. A third force stood between the two: the Adat party of chiefs and village elders, who on 21 February 1821 struck a deal with the Dutch at Padang and asked the colonial army to fight the clerics, turning an internal religious quarrel into a war fought with colonial troops. The front ran from the paddy fields of the lowlands up into the three luhak of Agam, Tanah Datar and Limo Puluah, and finally closed in on Fort Bonjol and Bukit Tajadi.
people: The best known leader on the Padri side was Tuanku Imam Bonjol. The northern figure was less a purifier of villages in the manner of Nan Renceh than a founder of towns and a diplomat: in the north he opened trading routes and built fortresses against the Dutch, he signed a peace with them in January 1824 only to see it broken by a new Dutch commander, in 1831 he attacked a Dutch garrison and, on the Dutch record, killed two thirds of the soldiers, and by September 1832 he had lost confidence in the extremism of the movement and left it. His brother Tuanku Rao was shot and badly wounded at the Battle of Air Bangis on 29 January 1833 and died shortly afterwards on the ship that was taking him into exile; Tuanku Tambusai stormed Fort Amerongen early that same year, and the Dutch counted eleven dead and twenty-four wounded. On the Dutch side the Resident of West Sumatra, James du Puy, directed the campaigning of 1821 to 1824; Lieutenant Colonel Raaff drove the Padri out of Pagaruyung in March 1822; Lieutenant Colonel Elout led repeated attacks between 1831 and 1833, and the reinforcements sent from Batavia in 1832 were commanded by Lieutenant Colonel Ferdinand P. Vermeulen Krieger. At the level of government, Governor-General Johannes van den Bosch came to Padang in person on 23 August 1833 to press the attack on Bonjol, and on 21 September admitted that it had failed; his successor Jean Chrétien Baud was followed by Dominique Jacques de Eerens, who sent Major General Cochius to take over, and the final siege from 16 March to 17 August 1837 was Cochius's, with Lieutenant Colonel Michiels taking the front line on 3 August. Sentot Prawirodirdjo, a renegade commander from the Java revolt, served with the Dutch for a time before being suspected of conspiracy and sent back to Java. Among the scholars, the specialist study of Christine Dobbin is the most used reference for this war.

kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍是十五世紀末西班牙的後膛手槍，靠發條帶動鋼輪摩擦輪緣的燧石點燃藥盤。到了一八二一年，它在西蘇門答臘的軍備中早已絕跡，只在米南加保的祖傳器與首長的儀仗裏作為古物存在，當地最接近的同類是荷葡胡椒貿易年代流入的舊式火槍與手槍，而荷軍軍官佩帶的則是十九世紀的燧發手槍。真正決定帕達里攻防的兵器有兩套。荷軍一方：燧發滑膛步槍配刺刀，十九世紀初的歐洲制式，火藥與鉛彈由海路運至巴東；青銅滑膛野戰砲，配合榴彈砲與迫擊砲，用於攻擊石砌堡壘；輔助部隊另有刀矛與短銃。帕達里一方：以荷葡舊式火槍為主，火藥自製，火器來源之一是能造火藥與火器的村社潘代·西克，荷方破約攻擊此村，正是要斷其火藥產能；近戰則用米南加保式的長刀與短矛。守軍在邦喬堡修有兩層石牆，牆高約三公尺，牆間挖四公尺寬的壕溝，牆頭密植長刺竹，既可觀察逼近的敵軍，亦可自牆上以砲火反擊。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on the card face was a Spanish breech-loading pistol of the late fifteenth century, in which a mainspring drives a steel wheel whose rim scrapes a pyrite to throw sparks into the priming pan. By 1821 it had long disappeared from the inventories of West Sumatra and survived only as an heirloom piece in Minangkabau families and in the regalia of chiefs; the nearest local counterparts were old muskets and pistols carried in through the Dutch and Portuguese pepper trade, while the pistols actually carried by Dutch officers were nineteenth century flintlocks. Two sets of weapons really decided the fighting at Padri. On the Dutch side: flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets, the European pattern of the early nineteenth century, with powder and lead shipped by sea to Padang; bronze smoothbore field guns with howitzers and mortars for attacking the stone works; and the auxiliaries with blades, spears and short guns. On the Padri side: old Dutch and Portuguese muskets as the main arm, with locally made powder, one source of guns and powder being the village of Pandai Sikek, whose attack by the Dutch was intended precisely to cut that supply; and for close fighting the Minangkabau long blade and short spear. The garrison of Fort Bonjol built two courses of stone wall about three metres high with a four metre ditch between them, and planted dense thorny bamboo along the parapet, both to watch the approaching Dutch and to fire cannon at them from the wall.
tactics: 荷軍的戰法是典型的殖民攻勢：先以縱隊沿山麓與河道推進，奪取一個據點便築堡固守，再以堡壘為跳板向內陸推進。一八二一年先取西馬旺與蘇利特·艾爾，一八二二年在巴圖桑加爾建范德·卡佩倫堡，一八三一年在武吉丁宜建德科克堡，同時修路築橋，把強行徵來的勞力用於運砲與糧秣。對邦喬堡的攻勢則是典型的圍城：荷軍逐步逼近至距堡約二百五十步，架起榴彈砲、迫擊砲與野戰砲射擊塔雅迪山，並逐個奪取山周制高點，卻屢遭帕達里方的夜襲與游擊，砲車與彈藥屢遭繳獲。帕達里方的戰術是守險與游擊並行：利用密林、峽谷與急流地形切斷荷軍的糧秣線，襲擊落單小隊與砲兵，凡有利守之地即築堡自守；一八三五年九月五日主動出堡反擊，摧毀荷軍在山周新築的工事。一八三六年出現轉折：荷方大量徵用本地兵充當前鋒，信任崩潰，最終釀成倒戈，荷軍被迫退回低地，也就無法再組織大規模攻勢。
tacticsEn: Dutch method was the classic colonial advance: push a column along the foothills and the river valleys, take a post, build a fort on it and hold, then use that fort as a springboard for the next push inland. In 1821 they took Simawang and Sulit Air; in 1822 they raised Fort Van der Capellen at Batusangkar; in 1831 they built Fort de Kock at Bukittinggi, and at the same time they made roads and bridges, using forced labour to haul guns and food. The attempt on Bonjol was a textbook siege: the Dutch worked forward until they stood about two hundred and fifty paces from the wall, emplaced howitzers, mortars and field guns to shell Bukit Tajadi, and took the heights around the hill one by one, while the Padri harried them by night, ambushed their columns and their guns, and repeatedly captured cannon and ammunition. The Padri method was defence and harassment in combination: they used the dense forest, the ravines and the fast rivers to cut the Dutch supply line, to fall on isolated detachments and on the artillery, and to fortify every defensible place they held; on 5 September 1835 they came out of the fort and destroyed the Dutch works thrown up around the hill. The turning point came in 1836: the Dutch raised a great many indigenous troops to serve as their spearhead, trust collapsed, the recruited men turned against their own side, and the Dutch were driven back to the lowlands, unable to mount another large offensive.
data: 可核對的日期與數字集中於幾個節點。一八二一年二月二十一日，阿達特貴族在巴東與荷方訂約；四月荷軍在戈菲內特與迪內馬率部進攻西馬旺與蘇利特·艾爾；十二月八日拉夫中校率援軍抵達。一八二二年三月四日荷軍逐出巴加魯榮的帕達里勢力；同年八月十四日巴索之戰荷軍指揮官受傷，同年在巴圖桑加爾荷軍整支部隊被殲、指揮官陣亡；一八二三年林套之戰荷軍敗退；一八二五年武吉丁宜之戰與蘇利特·艾爾之戰皆為帕達里勝利。馬桑條約之後戰事冷卻六年，因爪哇的大規模起義牽制了荷軍兵力。一八三三年一月十一日荷軍多個據點被襲，約一百三十九名歐洲士兵及數百名本地士兵陣亡；同月二十九日亞當·班吉斯之戰，圖安庫·拉奧中彈重傷；一八三五年六月十六日夜荷軍逼近邦喬堡約二百五十步、以砲火攻擊，傷亡慘重；九月五日帕達里出堡反擊，九月九日荷軍另一路攻擊再敗。最後一次圍城自一八三七年三月十六日至八月十七日，聯軍包括歐洲軍官一百四十八人、本地軍官三十六人、歐洲士兵一千一百零三人、本地士兵四千一百三十人（含馬都拉輔助部隊）；七月二十日佩爾勒號運來歐洲兵、印兵與自加納、馬利招募的非洲步兵（一名中士、四名下士、一百一十二名步槍兵）；八月十五日塔雅迪山失守，八月十六日邦喬堡完全陷落。戰役自荷軍介入至堡壘陷落，前後約十六年。
dataEn: The checkable dates and numbers cluster around a few nodes. On 21 February 1821 the Adat chiefs struck their deal with the Dutch at Padang; in April Dutch troops under Goffinet and Dienema advanced on Simawang and Sulit Air; and on 8 December Lieutenant Colonel Raaff arrived with reinforcements. On 4 March 1822 the Dutch drove the Padri out of Pagaruyung; on 14 August of the same year the Battle of Baso saw the Dutch commander wounded, and at Batusangkar a whole Dutch unit was destroyed and its commander killed; the Battle of Lintau in 1823 was a Dutch defeat; and the battles of Bukittinggi and Sulit Air in 1825 were Padri victories. After the Treaty of Masang the war cooled for six years, the Javanese revolts tying down Dutch troops. On 11 January 1833 several Dutch posts were attacked and about one hundred and thirty nine European soldiers and several hundred indigenous soldiers were killed; on the 29th of the same month Tuanku Rao was shot and badly wounded at Air Bangis; on the night of 16 June 1835 the Dutch closed to within about two hundred and fifty paces of Fort Bonjol and opened fire with guns, taking heavy losses; on 5 September the Padri sallied out and destroyed the Dutch works, and a second Dutch attack on 9 September failed as well. The last siege ran from 16 March to 17 August 1837, with a combined army of one hundred and forty eight European officers, thirty six indigenous officers, one thousand one hundred and three European soldiers and four thousand one hundred and thirty indigenous soldiers, Maduran auxiliaries included; on 20 July the Perle brought European troops, sepoys and African infantry recruited in Ghana and Mali, a sergeant, four corporals and one hundred and twelve flankeurs; on 15 August Bukit Tajadi fell and on the 16th Fort Bonjol was completely taken. From the Dutch intervention to the fall of the fort the war had run for about sixteen years.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因，是十八世紀末以來米南加保的伊斯蘭改革與母系阿達特制度的正面衝突。沙塔里蘇菲學派的烏里馬在村社設學堂傳道，朝覲歸來的學者主張以沙阿拉約束被視為不合教法的舊俗——鬥雞、賭博、鴉片、女性衣著與母系土地繼承——並要求清真寺與教法法庭主持公道。一八〇三年三名朝覲者與南倫什、林套等人組成八人核心，改革從此有了組織；一八一五年帕達里一度攻佔巴加魯榮王國，王室西遷，宗教衝突升級為王權與教權的對立。荷蘭的介入改變了性質：一八一九年英屬時期結束、荷蘭重掌西蘇門答臘後，荷方要在低地重建稅收與咖啡收購，高地達雷克的咖啡是荷蘭在歐洲的重要商品，荷方並在山麓設立直轄區與村社首長；阿達特貴族則需要外力保住世襲權與地租。二月二十一日的巴東密約把雙方綁在一起，此後荷軍的每一次推進都以咖啡產區與稅源為目標。國際層面上，一八二四年英荷條約劃定東印度群島歸荷蘭，英國對荷方的高壓手段頗有批評但未出手；爪哇的迪波內戈羅起義自一八二五年起牽制大量荷軍兵力，讓帕達里方得以在低地喘息六年。
causeEn: The war began as the collision in Minangkabau between nineteenth century Islamic reform and the matrilineal adat order. The ulama of the Shattari Sufi school taught in the villages and returned pilgrims from Mecca demanded that the sharia restrain what they saw as un-Islamic custom, cock-fighting, gambling, opium, the dress of women and matrilineal inheritance of land, and they wanted the mosques and the religious courts to dispense justice. Around 1803 the three returned pilgrims joined Nan Renceh, Lintau and others in a core of eight, and from then the reform had an organisation; in 1815 the Padri overran the Pagaruyung kingdom and the royal house fled west, and the religious quarrel turned into a contest of church and state. Dutch intervention changed its character. After the British period ended in 1819 and the Dutch regained West Sumatra, they wanted to rebuild the revenue and the coffee purchase in the lowlands, since coffee from the highland Dareh was a major Dutch commodity in Europe, and they set up direct districts and village headmen along the foothills; the Adat chiefs in turn needed outside force to keep their hereditary rights and their rent. The secret agreement at Padang of 21 February 1821 bound the two parties together, and every advance the Dutch army made after that was aimed at the coffee lands and the revenue. At the international level the Anglo-Dutch treaty of 1824 fixed the East Indies to the Dutch; Britain criticized the Dutch severity but did not act; and the Java revolt of Diponegoro, from 1825 onward, tied down large numbers of Dutch troops and gave the Padri six years of breathing space in the lowlands.
impact: 戰爭的結果改變了西蘇門答臘的權力結構。荷蘭以堡壘線、火砲與長期封鎖終於在高地站穩腳跟，但付出的代價遠超預期：一八三六年本地徵召兵倒戈，迫使荷方放棄攻勢；一八三七年三月開始的最後圍城雖然成功，卻靠的是從爪哇與西非不斷補進的援軍，而非在高地就地解決。以後荷當局改走雙軌統治：政治與經濟交給阿達特首長，宗教領域默許教法法庭保有相當自主，直到十九世紀末才逐步收回。另一條長線影響在思想層面：戰後宗教領袖與傳統首長逐步靠攏，形成以習俗立教法、以教法立經典的命題，成為米南加保伊斯蘭敘述的骨架，一直被後世引為傳統與教法可以調和的樣本。經濟上，內陸咖啡的種植與收購通道被打通，荷蘭得以把山區納入殖民出口體系；交通上，築路修橋與強徵勞工把高地與低地連成一體。軍事上，這場戰爭提供了殖民戰爭的教科書案例：以縱隊與砲兵攻擊游擊化的抵抗者代價極高，強行推進、封鎖與反游擊的組合才真正奏效，而一旦本地兵不願再為殖民軍作前鋒，攻勢就再難維持。
impactEn: The outcome changed the balance of power in West Sumatra. The Dutch gained a firm footing in the highlands through a line of forts, artillery and a long blockade, but at a cost far beyond what was expected: the mutiny of indigenous recruits in 1836 forced them to abandon the offensive, and the final siege beginning in March 1837 succeeded only because reinforcements kept arriving from Java and West Africa, not because the matter could be settled on the spot. From then on the colonial government governed on two tracks, leaving politics and the economy to the adat chiefs while allowing the religious courts a considerable independence that was only gradually withdrawn late in the nineteenth century. A second, longer line of effect lay at the level of ideas: after the war the religious leaders and the traditional chiefs moved closer to each other, and the formula of custom founded on the sharia and the sharia founded on the scripture took shape, becoming the backbone of the Minangkabau Islamic narrative and the standing example of tradition and religious law in balance. Economically the cultivation of coffee and the purchase route through the interior were opened up, and the highlands were folded into the colonial export system; in transport terms, roads, bridges and forced labour tied the highlands to the lowlands into one system. Militarily the war is a textbook case of colonial warfare: columns and artillery against a harassing resistance cost enormously, it was the combination of advance, blockade and counter-guerrilla that actually worked, and once indigenous men would no longer march at the head of a colonial column, no offensive could be sustained.
result: 就一八二一年介入以來算，荷軍完成了軍事目標：一八三三年佔領林套、阿甘姆與里莫普盧阿，一八三五年推進到巴當·阿蘭·潘長河谷，一八三六年十二月三日一度攻破邦喬堡部分防線仍被逐退，最終在一八三七年八月十五日奪下塔雅迪山、十六日攻陷邦喬堡。但結果並非全然：帕達里首領伊瑪目·邦喬在堡壘陷落前率眾退往馬拉帕克，未被生擒；一八三四年以來荷軍花大力氣修路築橋、徵用勞力，最終攻下的仍只是一座石堡，而教派在鄉村中的基礎並未因此消失。荷方在下一個世代轉向倫理政策，承認宗教與習慣的自主，換取合作。阿達特一方雖然失去了對抗的武力，卻保住了首長與地租的實權；教派一方失去的是城防與火藥來源，保留的則是清真寺網絡與鄉村號召力，兩者在往後數十年內長期共存於同一個框架之內。
resultEn: Judged from the Dutch intervention of 1821, the military aim was achieved: in 1833 the Dutch took Lintau, Agam and Limo Puluah, in 1835 they pushed into the Batang Alahan Panjang valley, on 3 December 1836 they breached part of Fort Bonjol and were driven out again, and in the end they carried Bukit Tajadi on 15 August 1837 and Fort Bonjol on the 16th. But the outcome was not clean. Tuanku Imam Bonjol, the Padri leader, withdrew with his followers towards Marapak before the fort fell and was never taken; the roads, bridges and forced labour the Dutch had laboured over since 1834 bought them, in the end, only a stone fort, and the movement's base in the villages was not destroyed by it. In the following generation the Dutch turned to an ethical policy, acknowledging the autonomy of religion and custom in exchange for cooperation. The Adat side, having lost the means of armed resistance, kept the real power over headmen and rent; the Padri side, having lost its walls and its powder, kept the mosque network and the capacity to mobilise the villages, and for decades the two lived on inside the same framework.
